name: haiku-scribe
description: Haiku Scribe: a read-only Haiku context-compression subagent, with a hook that routes broad reads to it.

plugins.name: haiku-scribe
plugins.description: Read-only Haiku scout subagent that compresses broad context (surveys, logs, transcripts, unfamiliar flow) into structured evidence, saving main-context headroom and stretching the Pro/Max cap. Ships a routing hook that declines the first broad read of a turn once and points it at the scout (HAIKU_SCRIBE_ROUTE=off disables it).
